notes: Reviewed openspec's 8 ACs. Modified AC2 (original said 'same discount logic' which is implementation-speak; revised to specify the observable arithmetic relationship between original fare, discount, and totals). Modified AC6 (original said 'appropriate locale format' which is vague; revised to specify observable locale formatting attributes: decimal separator, thousands separator, currency symbol placement). Added 4 new ACs: (1) percentage-based promo code edge case — the original ACs only implicitly cover fixed-amount promos; (2) discount-exceeds-fare edge case — prevents negative fare display; (3) rounding consistency for fractional currency — financial accuracy edge case not covered by original ACs; (4) email accessibility for screen readers — the promo code line must be parseable by assistive technology. Flagged AC5 for human review since the decision to display zero vs. hide the line is a UX choice that may vary by product preference.
